Unnamed: 1: Data are based on the Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics Sample Vital Registration System. For 2000–2010, population growth rates are based on annual growth. For 2011–2022, population growth rates are based on intercensal growth between the population censuses of 2001 and 2011.

Prior to 2016, estimates of GDP at current prices used the 2005/2006 base year. For 2016–2022, estimates of GDP at current prices were rebased using the 2015/2016 base year, reflecting more comprehensive coverage of economic activities and methodological changes.
For 2000–2010, data include electricity, gas, steam, and air-conditioning supply; water supply; and sewerage, waste management, and remediation activities.
For 2000–2010, data include wholesale and retail trade; repair of motor vehicles and motorcycles; and accommodation and food service activities.
For 2000–2010, data include transportation and storage; and information and communication.
For 2000–2010, accommodation and food service activities are included in wholesale and retail trade; repair of motor vehicles and motorcycles.
For 2000–2010, data for information and communication are included in transportation and storage.
For 2000–2010, real estate activities are included in other service activities.
For 2011–2015, data include real estate activities; professional, scientific, and technical activities; and administrative and support service activities.
For 2000–2010, administrative and support service activities are included in other service activities.

For 2000–2010, data include real estate, renting and business activities; education, health, and social work; and community, social, and personal services. For 2011 onward, data include community, social, and personal services.
